sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Your letter gives 51 days' notice (doc:20260911-70110-P01), while our framework agreement requires 90 days (ctr:4600070110#3.1).
Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -6.1% from 2025-11 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 10.1% (fc:310010@2026-09).

Please find our proposal below.
If faster payment helps you, we are open to it, as shown in the packages.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. We respect our framework agreement and therefore accept the effective date of 1 January 2027, as well as your proposed 14-day payment terms. Taking into account the development of energy costs and your increased volume forecast, we are pleased to revise our offer to a price of €133.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To ensure we can reliably meet your increased demand, please provide the detailed volume forecast for our production planning. Which volume can you commit to? Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. 

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

decisions.tactician: o2 has our lowest C, tied with E0 and o3. It moves the start to the contractually valid new-year date and keeps fourteen-day payment, which matches its cash need. E0 keeps the invalid November date, which we can contest with the notice argument (a1). o3's April date is unlikely to be valid under calendar-year pricing. The opening price is low but this is only our first counter, with room to concede toward the health price later. Citing the notice breach, falling power prices and our higher volume puts pressure on its stale costing.

why.tactician: Accepting its sheet gives our lowest total cost, below every option including E0. This is a stabilise case, so the relationship charge applies. E0 and the other options push the price under its sustainable margin, and the relationship charge then outweighs the lower unit price. Its €133.80 already sits near the health level on these terms. Pushing further would raise our total cost and strain a single-source supplier.
